disqualifier.note: Independent vocabulary-record drift axes between previous/next NormalizedRecord: contextual-alias context changes, additive range splits, and semantic/lineage/content drift can each fire alone; hasSemanticDrift ORs several free facts rather than masking a single phase.

Independent absolute-path shape classifiers (Windows drive vs POSIX/absolute vault root). isAbsoluteVaultRootPath composes the Windows probe with other absolute forms; both-false is ordinary relative input.

Independent env-var name safety axes: token-bearing-name rejection vs RFC-ish name pattern vs whole-map validity; isValidEnvVarName ANDs the first two, and map-level hasOnlyValidEnvVarNames aggregates free per-key outcomes.

evidence.note: hasValidTenantPlacement accepts only XOR of isTenantRoot and hasParentOrganization (a !== b); both-true and both-false are rejected as invalid tenant placement.

disqualifier.note: Independent per-block-kind structural validators; a mermaid code block, table, and YouTube block are validated on separate paths and all combinations of pass/fail across kinds are legal.
